text:
Eve (Marketing): quick kickoff: EdgeCloud marketplace listing + joint webinar + technical benchmark blog. need owners & a 2-week launch sprint plan. who can own what?
Diego (Partnerships): I can do marketplace listing + partner approvals. will need co-brand assets from EdgeCloud by Mon.
Asha (Product Marketing): i'll write the benchmark narrative and the short exec one-pager. propose metrics: median latency, p99 latency, cost/1k tokens, and rerank delta.
Tess (DevRel): i'll build the sample integration and a 4-min demo video. need infra matrix (model size, instance type). @Diego pls share EdgeCloud eng contact.
Ben (Demand Gen): i'll own webinar ops and email flow. need speakers, two promo emails, and a landing page by next Wed to hit a 2-week promo window. :calendar:
Nora (Sales Ops): for routing, recommend flags: lead_source=edge_marketplace, intent=demo|poe|info. hot leads -> AE queue, others -> nurture. we need UTM and hidden lead_code field.
Eve (Marketing): asset list: landing copy (me), listing (Diego), benchmark one-pager (Asha), demo + video (Tess), webinar emails + reg (Ben), routing spec (Nora).
Diego (Partnerships): EdgeCloud approved the co-brand template. uploading assets by Mon EOD.
Asha (Product Marketing): benchmark plan: run 50k queries across 3 prompt shapes, capture latency distribution and token cost. will include a reproducibility appendix.
Tess (DevRel): i'll add a repo README with run commands and a small Dockerfile. will tag release v0.1 and link from landing page.
Ben (Demand Gen): landing needs hidden fields: utm_source=edge_marketplace, utm_campaign=edge_integration_v1, lead_code=edge_v1. also add checkbox "Request demo" to mark hot leads.
Nora (Sales Ops): confirm: hot leads (checkbox + asked pricing) -> tag:edge_hot -> AE queue. i'll add routing rules in SFDC once Ben shares CSV mapping.
Eve (Marketing): messaging iteration flow: draft -> partner review -> legal check -> final. try to keep to 1 round of partner edits to avoid slipping schedule.
Diego (Partnerships): partner review window: Tue-Fri. provide drafts Tue morning and ask for comments by Thu.
Asha (Product Marketing): will aim to post benchmark blog + downloadable PDF same day as webinar to maximize SEO + registrant followup.
Tess (DevRel): small ask: can we host the demo on a static page on EdgeCloud docs or should we put on our CDN?
Diego (Partnerships): EdgeCloud OK w/our CDN for assets; they want co-hosted replay on their docs too.
Ben (Demand Gen): ops-bot: set webinar tentative date to 2024-07-18 09:00 PT.
launch-bot: Webinar tentative: 2024-07-18 09:00 PT. Calendar hold created.
Nora (Sales Ops): timeline check: if landing + emails ready Wed, i can enable routing + test by Thu.
Eve (Marketing): action items recap: owners confirm (today): Diego(listing), Eve(landing), Asha(benchmark), Tess(demo), Ben(webinar ops), Nora(routing). deliverable drafts Tue/Wed. next check-in: Thu 10am. thanks! :rocket:
